label: Browser CDP
summary: Soft-fail Chrome DevTools Protocol attach for browser automation without Playwright.
description: Browser pack. Attaches to an existing Chrome/Chromium instance via CDP HTTP endpoints (CDP_URL or BROWSER_CDP_URL). Presence-only status (host only; never returns full secrets). Soft-fail when CDP is not configured, network permission is denied, or the debug endpoint is unreachable. Pure JS; no Playwright dependency.

capabilities.label: CDP Status
capabilities.summary: Report whether CDP_URL / BROWSER_CDP_URL is configured (host only; no secrets).

capabilities.label: CDP Version
capabilities.summary: Soft GET {cdp}/json/version against the configured Chrome debug endpoint.

capabilities.label: CDP Targets
capabilities.summary: Soft GET {cdp}/json/list and map target id, title, type, url.

capabilities.label: CDP Navigate
capabilities.summary: Soft open/navigate via CDP HTTP /json/new (no WebSocket / Playwright).

permissions.reason: Attach to a local Chrome remote-debugging endpoint (e.g. 127.0.0.1:9222).
Attach to a non-local CDP endpoint when CDP_URL points off-localhost.
Optional future browser spawn; not used by the pure HTTP soft-attach path.
